fusions.name: Reaching Limb
fusions.desc: A limb reaches out to grab the first enemy in its path, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Uprooting Grip
fusions.desc: Grips a target at or below 25% of its health and wrenches it out, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Linked Branches
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles takes hold of your branches and strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Steady Limbs
fusions.desc: When you strike, your grip settles: your next strike has 12% more critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
